_about: Hand-written driver facts (State Blob White Paper V1, layer 6). Keyed by the roster's driver_id for humans and by spoken name for AI cars. 'facts' are always offerable (at most three are offered); 'armed' facts are offered only when their condition holds: on_podium, on_lead, on_win, on_retire. Keep every fact true and short; every capitalised word in a fact becomes sayable when it is offered, so no nicknames the driver would not want on air. Empty entries are fine -- this file is optional.

facts: Dustin told us he'd settle for third tonight, naming Mike and Cade as the two drivers he expects ahead of him.
Dustin's racing for Autism Center OK because family members are affected by autism, and he gave a shout-out to Asher.
Dustin says he'll bring the car home clean and dial down the aggression to fight at the end.
Dustin's pushing for pole in qualifying to avoid having to be aggressive in the race itself.
Dustin plans to pit late in the window hoping to take advantage of a potential yellow flag or safety car.
Dustin's sister is watching tonight.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna third was his target, and here he is on the podium.
armed.on_win: He told Sienna he'd settle for third, but he's brought it home for the win.
armed.on_retire: He told Sienna if he went out early he'd watch on a big screen and cheer for the human drivers.

facts: Alex told us he expects a battle if he goes side by side with Dustin after their contact and warnings last race.
Alex is racing for the NASCAR Foundation tonight because he thinks it's cool that it relates to cars.
Alex plans to save his tyres in qualifying and keep the car clean for consistency.
Alex predicts Mike, Cade and Dustin will fill the podium.
If Alex finds himself fourth in the final laps with charity money on the line, he told us he'll go for it.
Alex says his team name, Apex GP, came from AI.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna he'd go for it if charity money was on the line, and here he is.
armed.on_lead: He told Sienna his plan was consistency and clean racing, but he's leading the field.

facts: Shokin told us he is aiming for first place and plans to show everyone the rear view of his car all day.
Shokin named Dustin as his main rival, saying the two of them are always racing each other.
Shokin predicted Dustin will be too aggressive and crash into the wall.
Shokin has been away working on other projects but is back in the seat and looking to get going again.
Shokin always eats sushi before the race as a ritual for the Samurai.

armed.on_win: He told Sienna he was aiming for first and planned to show everyone his rear view all day, and he has done exactly that.
armed.on_retire: He told Sienna if his rival Dustin crashed he would be proven right about the aggression.
